about: Walkdown Plant realism vectors (docs/plant3d/REALISM.md §13), made by ref/make_plant3d_vectors.py from ref/plant3d.py, ref/plant3d_staff.py and ref/plant3d_world.py. Milestone RE1: the world's random streams by purpose and item (`streams`: each stream's first state and draws), and the synthetic plant with staff whose model reads the clock values (`staff`: its files, counts, rejects and runs, as plant3d-v2.json's `staff`; a run's `files` replace the base's, its `staff` null keeps the base's staff.json). Numbers compare to 1e-6; the digests (§17.14) of every 50th step are exact.
